# Illustration with scalar TS
```{r}
library(nsarfima)

## Package for FracDiff
library(FCVAR)

set.seed(100)

original_ts <- arfima.sim(
10000,
d = 1.5,
ar = 0.4,
ma = 0.3
)

# original series
x <- original_ts

# mean
mu <- mean(x)

# (1 - B)^(d)*(X - u) + (1 - B)^(d)*(u)

# (1 - B)^(d)*(X)

# diffseries (centered)
y_centered <- diffseries(x, d = 1.5)

# compute T(mu) using SAME operator
mu_vec <- rep(mu, length(x))
mu_fd <- FracDiff(matrix(mu_vec, ncol = 1), d = 1.5) %>% as.vector()

# corrected version
y_corrected <- y_centered + mu_fd

y_true <- FracDiff(matrix(x, ncol = 1), d = 1.5) %>% as.vector()

max(abs(y_corrected - y_true))


plot(mu_fd, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1, ylim = range(c(-5, 5)),
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Value")

lines(y_true, col = "red", lwd = 0.5)



diff_series_back = diffseries(diff_se, -1.5)
frac_diff_back = FracDiff(x = as.matrix(diff_se), d = -1.5) %>% as.vector()


plot(original_ts, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1, ylim = range(c(original_ts, diff_series_back, frac_diff_back)),
     xlab = "Time",
     ylab = "Value")

lines(diff_series_back, col = "red", lwd = 0.5)

lines(frac_diff_back, col = "blue", lwd = 0.5)


legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("Original", "diffseries transform", "FracDiff transform"),
       col = c("black", "red", "blue"),
       lwd = c(2,1,1))
```




# Illustration with FTS
```{r}
set.seed(100)

ref <- 101
v <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = ref)

# rows = time, cols = grid points
farma_0.8 <- sim_FARMA(
  n = 1000,
  d = 1.5,
  no_grid = ref,
  seed_number = 6,
  process = "FARMA",
  p = 1,
  q = 1
)

mu <- rowMeans(farma_0.8)
Y_centered <- t(apply(farma_0.8, 1, diffseries, d = 1.5))
Tn <- ncol(farma_0.8)

mu_mat <- matrix(mu, nrow = length(mu), ncol = Tn)

# apply SAME operator (no centering!)
mu_fd <- FracDiff(mu_mat, d = 1.5)

Y_corrected <- Y_centered + mu_fd

Y_true <- FracDiff(farma_0.8, d = 1.5)


Y_true - Y_corrected




farma_0.8_diff <- FracDiff(
  x = as.matrix(t(farma_0.8)),
  d = 1.5
) %>% t()


farma_back <- FracDiff(
  x = as.matrix(t(farma_0.8_diff)),
  d = -1.5
) %>% t()



idx <- floor(0.4 * ncol(farma_0.8)):floor(0.6 * ncol(farma_0.8))

orig_concat <- as.vector(farma_0.8[,900])
back_concat <- as.vector(farma_back[,900])

plot(orig_concat, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1,
     xlab = "Concatenated domain",
     ylab = "Value",
     ylim = range(c(orig_concat, back_concat)))

lines(back_concat, col = "red", lwd = 0.5)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Original", "Reconstructed"),
       col = c("black", "red"),
       lwd = c(1, 0.5))

farma_0.8[,idx] - farma_back[,idx] 


norm(farma_0.8 - farma_back, type = "F")

hannanrissanen_res(farma_0.8_diff)$theta[,,1] %>% image()



T_stationary(farma_0.8_diff)







# Step 4: inverse (corrected input)
farma_back <- FracDiff(farma_fd, d = -1.5)

# Step 5: final reconstruction
farma_final <- farma_back 



idx <- floor(0.4 * ncol(farma_0.8)):floor(0.6 * ncol(farma_0.8))

orig_concat <- as.vector(farma_0.8[,900])
back_concat <- as.vector(farma_final[,900])

plot(orig_concat, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1,
     xlab = "Concatenated domain",
     ylab = "Value",
     ylim = range(c(orig_concat, back_concat)))

lines(back_concat, col = "red", lwd = 0.5)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Original", "Reconstructed"),
       col = c("black", "red"),
       lwd = c(1, 0.5))

farma_0.8[,idx] - farma_back[,idx] 

norm(farma_0.8 - farma_back, type = "F")

```

    n = 600,
    d = 1.5,
    no_grid = 101,
    seed_number = 1,
    p = 2,
    q = 1,

  x = t(farma_0.8),
  d = 1.5
) %>% t()

  x = t(farma_0.8_diff),
  d = -1.5
) %>% t()

```{r}
extract_forecast_interval_metrics <- function(out)
{
  actual_detail <- out$actual_detail
  forecast_detail <- out$forecast_detail
  interval_detail <- out$interval_detail

  detail_list <- list()
  counter <- 1

  for(i in seq_len(nrow(interval_detail)))
  {
    seed_i <- interval_detail$seed[i]
    method_i <- interval_detail$method[i]
    window_i <- interval_detail$window_type[i]
    alpha_i <- interval_detail$alpha[i]
    step_i <- interval_detail$step[i]
    t0_i <- interval_detail$t0[i]

    idx_true <- which(
      actual_detail$seed == seed_i &
        actual_detail$step == step_i &
        actual_detail$t0 == t0_i
    )

    idx_forecast <- which(
      forecast_detail$seed == seed_i &
        forecast_detail$method == method_i &
        forecast_detail$window_type == window_i &
        forecast_detail$step == step_i &
        forecast_detail$t0 == t0_i
    )

    if(length(idx_true) == 0 || length(idx_forecast) == 0) next

    true_mat <- actual_detail$true[[idx_true[1]]]
    pred_mat <- forecast_detail$pred[[idx_forecast[1]]]
    error_mat <- forecast_detail$error[[idx_forecast[1]]]

    lower_mat <- interval_detail$lower[[i]]
    upper_mat <- interval_detail$upper[[i]]

    h_max <- ncol(true_mat)

    for(h in seq_len(h_max))
    {
      true_h <- as.numeric(true_mat[, h])
      pred_h <- as.numeric(pred_mat[, h])
      error_h <- as.numeric(error_mat[, h])
      lower_h <- as.numeric(lower_mat[, h])
      upper_h <- as.numeric(upper_mat[, h])

      ok_interval <- is.finite(true_h) &
        is.finite(lower_h) &
        is.finite(upper_h)

      ok_forecast <- is.finite(true_h) &
        is.finite(pred_h) &
        is.finite(error_h)

      true_interval <- true_h[ok_interval]
      lower_interval <- lower_h[ok_interval]
      upper_interval <- upper_h[ok_interval]

      error_forecast <- error_h[ok_forecast]

      below <- true_interval < lower_interval
      above <- true_interval > upper_interval

      score_point <- (upper_interval - lower_interval) +
        2 / alpha_i * (
          (lower_interval - true_interval) * below +
            (true_interval - upper_interval) * above
        )

      detail_list[[counter]] <- data.frame(
        seed = seed_i,
        method = method_i,
        window_type = window_i,
        alpha = alpha_i,
        step = step_i,
        t0 = t0_i,
        h = h,
        cover_count = sum(
          true_interval >= lower_interval &
            true_interval <= upper_interval
        ),
        miss_count = sum(below) + sum(above),
        interval_score_sum = sum(score_point),
        width_sum = sum(upper_interval - lower_interval),
        SSE = sum(error_forecast^2),
        SAE = sum(abs(error_forecast)),
        SE = sum(error_forecast),
        n_interval = length(true_interval),
        n_forecast = length(error_forecast)
      )

      counter <- counter + 1
    }
  }

  step_detail <- dplyr::bind_rows(detail_list)

  summary <- step_detail %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    method,
    window_type,
    alpha,
    h
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    ECP = sum(cover_count, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(n_interval, na.rm = TRUE),

    interval_score = sum(
      interval_score_sum,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / sum(
      n_interval,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    width = sum(
      width_sum,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / sum(
      n_interval,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    RMSE = sqrt(
      sum(SSE, na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(n_forecast, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),

    MAE = sum(
      SAE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / sum(
      n_forecast,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    ME = sum(
      SE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / sum(
      n_forecast,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_test = dplyr::n_distinct(step),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CPD = abs(ECP - (1 - alpha)),
    .after = ECP
  )

  list(
    step_detail = step_detail,
    summary = summary
  )
}
```

```{r}
diagnose_one_step_farma_far <- function(X,
                                        d_hat,
                                        t0,
                                        h_max = 10,
                                        p_est = 1,
                                        q_est = 1,
                                        Npc = 1,
                                        far_pve = 0.95)
{
  X_history <- X[, 1:t0, drop = FALSE]

  if(d_hat == 0) {
    Y_history <- X_history
  } else {
    Y_history <- frac_difference_history(
      X_history = X_history,
      d_hat = d_hat
    )
  }

  out <- forecast_original_scale(
    Y_train = Y_history,
    d_hat = d_hat,
    h = h_max,
    method = "both",
    p_est = p_est,
    q_est = q_est,
    Npc = Npc,
    far_pve = far_pve,
    Y_history_for_integration = Y_history,
    return_fit = FALSE
  )

  X_true_future <- X[, (t0 + 1):(t0 + h_max), drop = FALSE]

  if(d_hat == 0) {
    Y_true_future <- X_true_future
  } else {
    X_known <- X[, 1:(t0 + h_max), drop = FALSE]

    Y_known <- frac_difference_history(
      X_history = X_known,
      d_hat = d_hat
    )

    Y_true_future <- Y_known[, (t0 + 1):(t0 + h_max), drop = FALSE]
  }

  make_rows <- function(method_name)
  {
    Y_pred <- out[[method_name]]$Y_future
    X_pred <- out[[method_name]]$X_future

    rows <- lapply(1:h_max, function(h) {
      err_Y <- Y_pred[, h] - Y_true_future[, h]
      err_X <- X_pred[, h] - X_true_future[, h]

      data.frame(
        method = method_name,
        h = h,
        RMSE_Y = sqrt(mean(err_Y^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        RMSE_X = sqrt(mean(err_X^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
        amplification = sqrt(mean(err_X^2, na.rm = TRUE)) /
          sqrt(mean(err_Y^2, na.rm = TRUE))
      )
    })

    dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    make_rows("far"),
    make_rows("farma")
  )
}
```

```{r}
diagnose_rolling_farma_far <- function(X,
                                       d_hat,
                                       t0_set,
                                       h_max = 10,
                                       p_est = 1,
                                       q_est = 1,
                                       Npc = 1,
                                       far_pve = 0.95)
{
  out_list <- list()

  for(i in seq_along(t0_set))
  {
    tmp <- tryCatch(
      diagnose_one_step_farma_far(
        X = X,
        d_hat = d_hat,
        t0 = t0_set[i],
        h_max = h_max,
        p_est = p_est,
        q_est = q_est,
        Npc = Npc,
        far_pve = far_pve
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if(!is.null(tmp))
    {
      tmp$t0 <- t0_set[i]
      out_list[[length(out_list) + 1]] <- tmp
    }
  }

  dplyr::bind_rows(out_list)
}
```
